question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the crowd activity at DemoBooth_NVIDIA versus DemoBooth_Intel. Which booth was busier, and approximately what was the ratio of their average head_counts?
answer_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), DemoBooth_NVIDIA was busier than DemoBooth_Intel, with an average head count of 15.52 compared to Intel's 10.65. The ratio of their average head counts was approximately 1.46:1, indicating that the NVIDIA booth had about 46% more crowd activity than the Intel booth.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AND ch.camera_location = 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'
  RETURN 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA' AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_head_count
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AND ch.camera_location = 'DemoBooth_Intel'
  RETURN 'DemoBooth_Intel' AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_head_count
}
WITH collect({location: location, avg_head_count: avg_head_count}) AS results
RETURN 
  results[0].location AS location1, 
  results[0].avg_head_count AS avg_head_count1, 
  results[1].location AS location2, 
  results[1].avg_head_count AS avg_head_count2, 
  CASE 
    WHEN results[1].avg_head_count <> 0 THEN results[0].avg_head_count / results[1].avg_head_count 
    ELSE null 
  END AS ratio
ORDER BY location1, location2
